text: 1. Photocopie du passeport valide With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Photo de passeport A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Diplôme de master Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Relevé de notes de l'école postgraduate 5. HSK Certificat 6. Deux lettres de recommandation From professor,associate professor or equivalents.
